title: Grell
wikitext:
[[image:Grell.png|thumb|]]
A small type of [[demon]], grells are similar in appearance to [[Imp|imps]], but are generally larger in size and lack the characteristic horns.  Grells come in both melee and spellcaster variants. They are common to [[Shadowglen]] and [[Fel Rock]] in [[Teldrassil]], and [[Bashal'Aran]] in [[Darkshore]].

Grells are also known as sprites, although this term is shared with the more benign [[Faerie_Dragon|faerie dragons]].
